entries.name: Initiative
entries.notes: d20 plus Initiative modifier; rolls are recorded.

entries.name: Weapon attack rolls
entries.notes: AC checks, natural 1 misses, and natural 20 hits are implemented.

entries.name: Weapon critical hits
entries.notes: A natural 20 doubles weapon and eligible conditional damage dice.

entries.name: Advantage and Disadvantage
entries.notes: Multiple sources collapse using the normal cancellation rule.

entries.name: Weapon range
entries.notes: Melee reach, normal range, long range, and close-ranged Disadvantage are implemented.

entries.name: Movement
entries.notes: Speed, closing distance, retreat movement, and remaining movement are tracked.

entries.name: Dash
entries.notes: Dash spends the Action and grants extra movement equal to Speed.

entries.name: Hit Points and defeat
entries.notes: Damage, healing, 0 HP defeat, and winner events are implemented for arena duels.

entries.name: Fighter Second Wind
entries.notes: Uses, Bonus Action cost, healing, and max-HP cap are implemented.

entries.name: Light weapon extra attack
entries.notes: A Light-weapon Attack-action attack can enable one different Light-weapon extra attack; Bonus Action cost, once-per-turn use, and ability-modifier damage rules are implemented.

entries.name: Two-Weapon Fighting style
entries.notes: The style restores the ability modifier to damage for the Light-property extra attack.

entries.name: Nick mastery
entries.notes: A mastered Nick weapon can make the Light-property extra attack inside the Attack action instead of spending the Bonus Action; it does not grant a second Light extra attack.

entries.name: Longsword Sap
entries.notes: Next-attack Disadvantage and start-of-source-turn expiry are implemented.

entries.name: Vex mastery
entries.notes: Target-specific next-attack Advantage through the end of the wielder's next turn is implemented for mastered weapons.

entries.name: Goblin Advantage damage
entries.notes: The Goblin Warrior's conditional d4 damage applies only when its attack has Advantage.

entries.name: Opportunity Attacks
entries.notes: Leaving melee reach can spend a Reaction for one melee attack before movement resolves.

entries.name: Disengage
entries.notes: Disengage suppresses Opportunity Attacks for retreat movement during the current turn.

entries.name: Reactions
entries.notes: Reaction availability and Opportunity Attacks are implemented; other Reaction features are not.

entries.name: Goblin Nimble Escape
entries.notes: Bonus Action Disengage and retreat are implemented; Hide is not yet implemented.

entries.name: Hide
entries.notes: Requires concealment, visibility, and Stealth state.

entries.name: Conditions
entries.notes: General condition rules are not implemented.

entries.name: Cover
entries.notes: Battlefield cover and line-of-effect rules are not implemented.

entries.name: Spells
entries.notes: Spellcasting is outside the current duel slice.

entries.name: Death Saving Throws
entries.notes: The arena currently treats 0 HP as defeat.

entries.name: Initiative ties
entries.notes: The arena currently uses Initiative bonus as its deterministic tie-breaker.

entries.name: Arena geometry
entries.notes: Current combat uses one-dimensional distance in an open arena and assumes opponents are visible.
